description: Read, compile, or approve a project's training curriculum (Step 18 Curriculum Compiler): compile parses the label config into a SkillGraph and generates per-skill micro-lessons from the project instructions (one cached pass per version); approve passes the mandatory human gate. Requires learning:read (read) / learning:write (compile/approve) and project ownership.

action.description: read = fetch the compiled curriculum; compile = run the one-pass generation from the latest project version (force recompiles); approve = pass the mandatory human gate so the course can reach workers.

name: opentrain_learning_curriculum
